title: 第十一章 睡了别人也是有代价的
slug: 恶毒雌性玩的花兽世大佬排队跪
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

姜枝怔在原地。

可等真正看清洞口那道身影，姜枝脑子里却忽然“嗡”了一下，像有什么尘封多年的东西，被人猝不及防地掀开了。

男人站在半掀的草帘下，逆着洞外的光。

五官冷峻分明，鼻梁挺直，眉骨压得很低，那双幽蓝色的眼瞳像夜色下结了冰的湖面，安静看人时总带着一种高高在上的疏离感。

姜枝在看清翎夜脸的那一瞬间，脑子里像忽然被什么东西狠狠撞了一下。

不属于她的记忆，不属于她的情绪，不属于她的执念，像涨潮一样猛地从这具身体深处翻涌上来，毫无预兆地冲进四肢百骸。

那些零碎的、混乱的、滚烫的画面一股脑挤进来——

远远跟在他身后时的雀跃。

看见他和云知站在一起时的嫉妒。

为了多和他说一句话，故意把自己弄得狼狈不堪的委屈。

还有一次又一次，被他冷淡忽视之后，仍旧不肯死心的痴迷。

姜枝甚至来不及反应，视线就已经黏在了那人身上，挪都挪不开。

她立刻反应过来——

这不是她的情绪。

这是原主残留在身体里的本能。

人都死了，居然还能留这么大后劲？

而洞口那人显然把她这一瞬间的失神，全看进了眼里，嗤笑一声，掀着草帘，慢悠悠走了进来。

未成年雌性的山洞，不是谁都能随便进的。除了轮值的成年雌性，也只有首领有资格偶尔过来看一眼，确认小雌性们是否安好。

几个小雌性一看见他，立刻都安静下来，缩着肩膀坐好。

云知轻轻抬眼，低声唤了一句：“翎夜。”

翎夜却没看她。

“希望你说道做到，”翎夜的目光落在姜枝脸上，“以后请不要再纠缠我。”

Page (1/3)

Jiang Zhi was stunned in place.

But when he really saw the figure at the entrance of the cave, Jiang Zhi's mind suddenly buzzed, as if something that had been dusty for many years had been opened unexpectedly.

The man stood under the half-lifted straw curtain, facing the light outside the cave.

His facial features are sharp and sharp, his nose is straight, his brows are very low, his blue eyes are like a frozen lake at night, and he always has a sense of superiority and alienation when he looks at people quietly.

The moment Jiang Zhi saw Ling Ye's face clearly, something suddenly hit him hard in his head.

Memories that did not belong to her, emotions that did not belong to her, and obsessions that did not belong to her surged up from the depths of this body like a rising tide, rushing into the limbs without warning.

Those fragmented, chaotic, and hot pictures were squeezed in all at once——

The joy of following him from a distance.

Seeing his jealousy when he and Yun Zhi stood together.

In order to say one more word to him, I deliberately made myself embarrassed and aggrieved.

And again and again, after being ignored by him, she still refuses to give up her obsession.

Jiang Zhi didn't even have time to react, his eyes were already glued to that person and he couldn't move away.

She reacted immediately——

This is not her emotion.

This is the instinct left in the body of the original owner.

Everyone is dead, but there is still so much energy left?

The man at the entrance of the cave obviously saw her momentary loss of concentration, sneered, lifted the straw curtain, and walked in slowly.

Not everyone can enter the cave of an underage female.In addition to the adult females on duty, only the leader is qualified to occasionally come over and check to see if the little females are okay.

When the little females saw him, they immediately became quiet and sat down with their shoulders hunched.

Yun Zhi raised his eyes gently and called in a low voice: "Ling Ye."

Lingye didn't look at her.

"I hope you will do what you say," Ling Ye's eyes fell on Jiang Zhi's face, "Please don't pester me again in the future."
